description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It implements menu configuration for the performance tracker feature, specifically overriding the screen when configured.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for performance tracking, overriding the screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker' when invoked.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker' by utilizing a method from a trait, then returns null.
